title: Fix '+ Add Prompt' Save to persist prompts and categories

requirements.text: Fix the '+ Add Prompt' Save flow so a newly created prompt is reliably persisted (backend + in-memory UI state) instead of the dialog closing with the prompt missing.

quotes: When I go to "+ Add Prompt"  and fill out the area that I am asked to fill out and then push save, it is not saving.

acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new prompt (Title + Content + at least one Category) and clicking Save results in the prompt appearing in the currently active view/filter state as soon as Save completes.
After a full page refresh and re-authentication, the newly created prompt is still present (loaded from the backend).
If the backend call fails, the dialog remains open and an error toast is shown; the prompt is not silently lost.

requirements.text: Ensure categories entered/selected in the prompt editor are persisted so that any new category created during '+ Add Prompt' appears under Favorites in the category filter bar immediately after saving the prompt and remains after refresh.

quotes: a category should be showing and when I click that category it should pop up.
I can manually put in a category or pick one that exist.

acceptanceCriteria: When saving a prompt that includes a brand-new category name, that category appears in the CategoryFilterBar list (under the Favorites button) without requiring a manual refresh action.
After a full page refresh and re-authentication, the new category is still present in the CategoryFilterBar list (loaded from backend).
Saving a prompt with only existing categories does not create duplicate categories in the UI list or backend.

requirements.text: Make clicking a category in the CategoryFilterBar correctly filter and allow opening prompts within that category, using the currently selected view mode (list/grid/table) behavior.

quotes: when I click that category it should pop up.
whichever format I have chosen right next to the Newest First drop box.

acceptanceCriteria: After saving a prompt into a category, clicking that category filters the prompt list to show the prompt(s) in that category.
In list/grid/table view modes, selecting a prompt in the filtered results opens the existing prompt preview behavior for that view (no broken/empty preview).
The app stays on the current view after Save (no forced navigation).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Implementing new sorting modes, new view modes, or a new navigation system.
Changing authentication provider behavior (Internet Identity only).
Adding external databases or third-party storage.
